name: Cut the cloud toolchain setup from 15 minutes to a couple
body: Dean (2026-11-16): 15 minutes per thread is unacceptable, and he is not always on the laptop with a local toolchain. Time each step of cloud-bootstrap.sh, then move the slow work out of the per-thread path: bake nox, mist and the mist-built dependencies into the cloud environment's setup script (runs once, not per thread), keep the bootstrap as a fast check and a source-build fallback, update docs/cloud-testing.md. Show before and after timings in the PR.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh cloud thread reaches a passing mist run test in a couple of minutes
Timings per step before and after are in the PR
